children: Coty appointed Soraya Benchikh as Chief Financial Officer while Laurent Mercier ceased serving as CFO and began serving as Strategic CEO Advisor through June 30, 2027.
Strategic CEO Advisor (formerly Chief Financial Officer)
Transition from CFO to Strategic Advisor
September 1, 2026 (began advisory role); Transition End Date June 30, 2027 (may be accelerated to no earlier than Dec 20, 2026)
Effective prior to September 1, 2026 (appointed as CFO; filing references previously announced appointment)
Company's leadership transition following appointment of new CFO
Replaced as CFO by Soraya Benchikh

Will receive annual base salary of €825,000 through Transition End Date; available to assist in Sept–Oct 2026, released from active duties Nov 1, 2026; eligible for one-time bonus €290,000; equity vesting in Oct 2026 remains; subject to 12-month non-competition and related payments; entitled to contractual/collective severance benefits.
Not disclosed in Item 5.02 (appointment described as previously announced)
